acceptanceCriteria: One generator invocation produces REQUIREMENTS.tsv, INDEX.json and README.md from a single read of the staged specs, with byte-identical outputs to the current three-pass generator (test retained).
Blob reads are pipelined through one cat-file batch process rather than one synchronous request per file; the SRG-V0-001 Git-index-only rule is unchanged.
Measured: `make spec-requirements` and `make spec-requirements-check` wall and CPU before and after on the same host, retained.
body: Evidence: owner-requested performance search on 2026-10-17. Measured with corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 615, corvint-tasks build 615, Go 1.27.2, macOS 12-core/64 GB host at load average 80-84 (wall times are inflated by load; CPU times are the stable signal). Lane counts come from orchestrator session 03e2afac subagent transcripts (206 lanes). SPEC_GENERATE in the Makefile runs script/gen-spec-requirements.sh three times (tsv, --index, --readme). Each run reads all 207 tracked docs/specs files through a `git cat-file --batch` co-process, but writes one request and waits for its reply before the next, so a pass makes 207 sequential round trips. Measured at load 82: the three passes took 9.83 s, 11.31 s and 12.66 s wall for 0.8-0.9 s user each; a full `make spec-requirements` took 52.71 s wall for 4.55 s CPU. Lanes ran `make spec-requirements` 188 times (1.59 h, p50 25.9 s) plus spec-requirements-check (p50 41.4 s), which runs the same three passes before `go test ./internal/specindex`. Expected: one pass reads each blob once and emits all three outputs, and batch requests are pipelined (write all paths, then read the replies in order) so wall time tracks CPU. Related: V1-1525 (generated file conflicts between lanes), V1-0515.
title: make spec-requirements takes 34-52 s for about 3 s of CPU: three full passes, each with 207 synchronous cat-file round trips
